products.description:
Toronto CN Tower Cross Stitch Pattern PDF is a downloadable digital counted cross-stitch pattern from Drielo's Iconic Destinations collection.

The artwork uses an exact 100 × 120 source grid: one image pixel equals one full cross stitch, so the chart does not reinterpret or distort the design.

Pattern details

  • Code: D0006-CS
  • Grid: 100 × 120 stitches
  • Total stitches: 12,000
  • Colours: 21 DMC colours selected for this design
  • Technique: Full cross stitch
  • Skill level: Intermediate

What you receive

Printable PDF with finished preview, DMC key, colour and symbol charts, four enlarged chart sections and working guide.

Digital product only. Personal use only.
